fichas.title: Compact hospital planning and space allocation
fichas.summary: Planning guidance for a compact hospital of approximately 200 beds, including departmental relationships, site organization, space allocation, and provisions for future expansion and changes of use. The site diagram shows patient gardens, staff and visitor parking, emergency and ambulance access, supply and disposal, outpatient services, an operating theatre, X-ray, administration, and a two-corridor system.

fichas.title: Modular coordination for hospital design
fichas.summary: The page recommends modular coordination as the basis for hospital design. A reference system, basic module, and multiples of the module coordinate the purpose, location, and dimensions of building elements. A basic grid in horizontal and vertical directions defines the load-bearing structure; modular coordination is described as supporting shorter construction times and simpler replacement of finishing elements.
uses: Establish the basic grid and load-bearing structure
Facilitate construction and replacement of finishing elements

fichas.title: Structural grid for hospital departments
fichas.summary: Structural-grid guidance emphasizes route planning and zoning for main functions, subsidiary functions, and traffic. Grids of 7.20 m or 7.80 m are cited as successful in practice; a smaller 3.60 m × 7.20 m grid is also possible. The illustrated examination and treatment-area diagram shows a 28.80 m building depth and additional grid and zone dimensions. Reinforced-concrete slabs without downstand beams are recommended to simplify service routing.
